canonicalLegalEntityId.description: Canonical legal-entity identifier from contracts/legal-entity/registry.yaml. Responses, persisted records and events must use this form.

legacyLegalEntityAlias.description: Legacy control-plane alias accepted at documented input boundaries during the v1 compatibility window only.

legalEntityIdInput.description: Compatibility input union. Consumers must resolve aliases and emit only canonicalLegalEntityId values.

legalEntityId.description: Backward-compatible definition name for canonical legal-entity output and persistence contracts.

tenantId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted tenant identifier. It must not contain a legal-entity, country, market or vendor identity.

productId.description: Version-1 product identifier. Canonical engine products use kebab case; underscore aliases remain accepted during migration.
